title: Move shared SVG and cache helpers from quire_mermaid into a common module
boundary: Not in this slice: any behavior change, cache layout change, or edits to quire.py and test_quire.py.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: quire_math imports SVG_NS, prefix_svg and validate_svg from quire_mermaid, and both renderers carry their own copy of the XDG cache-root logic. Shared helpers belong in a neutral module.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- quire_common.py (new)
- quire_mermaid.py, quire_math.py
- test_render.py, test_render_integration.py
- AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. test_render imports validate_svg and prefix_svg from quire_common.
2. A cache_directory(name) test covers XDG and home roots.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Move SVG_NS, validate_svg, prefix_svg to quire_common; add cache_directory(name); mermaid and math import them.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: python3 test_quire.py; black/flake8 on touched files.
